title: GRADE Normalized Model Output
description: Contract for the normalized output produced by any model adapter after running a GRADE task. Scorers (C1–C4) consume this format. The runner adapter is responsible for mapping raw model responses into this structure before scoring.

task_id.description: The task_id from the task definition this output corresponds to.

model_id.description: Fully qualified model identifier, e.g. 'openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-4-7' or 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'.

run_index.description: 0-based repetition index within the (model × task) run set. GRADE uses 5 runs per pair; valid range is 0–4.

structured_metrics.description: Quantitative or categorical values extracted from the model response. Keys are metric names (snake_case); values are the extracted scalars, lists, or objects. This is the primary surface for C1 (Grounding Accuracy) automated fact-checking.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON-serializable value: number, string, boolean, array, or object.

key_findings.description: Ordered list of substantive analytical conclusions in the model's response. Each finding is a complete sentence or short paragraph. The C3 (Insight Quality) scorer evaluates these against gold_insights.

limitations.description: Uncertainty statements, caveats, or data limitations the model explicitly acknowledged. Evaluated by the C3 (Calibration & Limitation Handling) scorer against required_limitations in the task definition.

evidence_citations.description: Explicit references the model made to source data (file names, table names, row ranges, column names, etc.). Evaluated by the C2 (Evidence Linkage) scorer.

runtime_metadata.description: Operational metadata recorded by the adapter. Used for reproducibility and debugging; never exposed as a public scoring dimension.

raw_response_text.description: Optional: verbatim model response text, preserved for human review and manual scoring. May be null if the adapter redacts it for privacy.

EvidenceCitation.description: One explicit evidence reference made by the model.

citation_text.description: The exact text of the citation as it appeared in the model output.

source_file.description: Fixture file the citation refers to, if identifiable (e.g. 'sessions.csv').

source_column.description: Column or field name within source_file, if identifiable.

grounded.description: Scorer-filled field: true if the citation was verified against the fixture, false if fabricated, null if not yet checked.

RuntimeMetadata.description: Adapter-recorded operational data for reproducibility. Not scored publicly.

adapter_version.description: Semantic version of the runner adapter that produced this output, e.g. '0.1.0'.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the model call completed, e.g. '2026-06-01T12:34:56Z'.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency of the model API call in milliseconds.

prompt_tokens.description: Token count of the prompt sent to the model, if available from the provider.

completion_tokens.description: Token count of the model's completion, if available.

model_temperature.description: Temperature setting used for the model call. Null if the adapter used the provider default.

provider.description: API provider used for the call, e.g. 'openrouter', 'anthropic', 'openai'.

pack_id.description: Fixture pack identifier the task was run against, e.g. 'pack_operations', 'pack_outcomes', 'pack_equity_research'.
